bugs.name: Saving the Edit Label dialog for a label deleted meanwhile lands on a bare plain-text "Not Found" page
bugs.summary: The Save posts to /eval/harbor-handbook/labels/edit, which answers 404, and the browser is left on a bare white page containing only the text \"Not Found\" — no site header, no message about the deleted label, no way back except the browser's Back button. The typed changes are lost. Reproduced twice (once with the label qa-s-dbl, once with qa-s-dbl2). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels (Edit Label dialog, deleted from a second tab))
bugs.expected: The label no longer exists, so the app should say so (for example a red \"This label has been deleted\" message on the labels list) and return the person to the list, instead of rendering a raw \"Not Found\" page.
bugs.actual: The Save posts to /eval/harbor-handbook/labels/edit, which answers 404, and the browser is left on a bare white page containing only the text \"Not Found\" — no site header, no message about the deleted label, no way back except the browser's Back button. The typed changes are lost. Reproduced twice (once with the label qa-s-dbl, once with qa-s-dbl2).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open https://5503-ig6idqpc9wl8ew3cs6uan.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels in tab A
In tab A click "New Label", type the name "qa-s-dbl2", type a colour such as "#abcdef" and click "Save"
Open the same labels page in a second tab (tab B) and in tab B click "Edit" on the "qa-s-dbl2" row so the Edit Label dialog stays open
Back in tab A reload the page, click "Delete" on the "qa-s-dbl2" row and click "Confirm" (the list now says "The label has been deleted.")
Return to tab B, where the Edit Label dialog for qa-s-dbl2 is still open, and click "Save"

bugs.name: Assigning a label that was deleted meanwhile answers 500 and fails silently
bugs.summary: The label gets a check mark as if assigned, and nothing tells the user anything is wrong. When the picker is closed the request POST /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels fails with 500 Internal Server Error, the check mark is gone, the sidebar still shows only "documentation" and no error message is displayed anywhere. The stale deleted label also remains in the picker's list until the page is reloaded. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/7 (sidebar label picker))
bugs.expected: The app tells the user the label could not be applied (it no longer exists) instead of failing silently with a 500 server error, and the deleted label does not stay listed as assignable.
bugs.actual: The label gets a check mark as if assigned, and nothing tells the user anything is wrong. When the picker is closed the request POST /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels fails with 500 Internal Server Error, the check mark is gone, the sidebar still shows only "documentation" and no error message is displayed anywhere. The stale deleted label also remains in the picker's list until the page is reloaded.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.
On /eval/harbor-handbook/labels create a label named 'agent11-vanish' (description 'Agent11 delete while picker open test', colour #ff8800) and Save.
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/7 (issue 'agent11-dialog-fixture') and open the label picker from the 'Labels' row of the right sidebar — 'agent11-vanish' is listed.
In a second browser tab open /eval/harbor-handbook/labels and delete the label 'agent11-vanish' (Delete → Confirm, page says 'The label has been deleted.').
Back in the first tab, click 'agent11-vanish' in the still-open picker — a check mark appears next to it as if the label had been assigned.
Click somewhere else on the issue page to close the picker.
